page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Two short numbered paragraphs (LXV, LXVI) are set centred within the column. Signature at the foot.

main_text.p: struis laborantem ne accedito, ut cum ea rem habeas. Alterius uxori stuprum & corruptelam ne inferto. Progeniem tuam ne dato traijciendam Molocho, neve meum Jova Dei tui nomen profanato. Marem ne fœmineo concubitu comprimito: nefas est. Ne te ullius bestiæ concubitu contaminato, neve mulier bestiæ prostrato ad coeundum: flagitium est. Ne vos ullo horum scelerum contaminatote. Nam his omnibus sese contaminarunt gentes, quas ego vobis abigo. Itaque si polluta terra scelera hujusmodi pœnis persequor, ut incolas terra suos evomat. Levit. 18.

p.i: Si qua hominis sacerdotis filia scortari aufa fuerit, patrem suum profanavit, igni cremator.

main_text.p: Tum Moses Jsraelitis ex Jovæ mandato præcepit, in hunc modum: Recte dicunt Josephi natorum tribules, atque hoc est, quod Jova circa Salphaadi filias præcipit: Suo arbitratu nubunto, dum in tri-

page.notes: Paragraph marks (decorative ornaments) stand before "Alterius", "Marem", "Ne te" and "Ne vos" in the text; they are not printed words and are not transcribed. The word "contaminatote" is printed with a mark after it, which is not transcribed. "aufa" and "cremator" are printed as they stand and may be printing errors (for "ausa" and "crematur"). "Iova"/"Ifraelitis" are transcribed with consonant J as required. The running text ends mid-word at "tri-" with a printed hyphen. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
